meta.name: Census of India - state and UT series 1901-2011 (population, sex ratio, urban share, literacy)
meta.source_org: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Census of India); Ministry of Finance (Economic Survey 2021-22); MoSPI (SSES 2017)
meta.url: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/43333 (Table A-2, one catalog page per state)
meta.limitations: Population, males and females are on 2011 boundaries (Table A-2). Urban share and literacy for 1951-2001 are on the state boundaries of each census year (states formed in 2000 are recast by the Census). They stay null for AP, TG, JK, LA and DH before 2011 because these boundaries changed. Urban share exists for 1991, 2001 and 2011 only. 2011 urban share and literacy come from district counts on present boundaries. Literacy age basis changes: 1951-1971 age 5+, 1981 onward age 7+. Assam 1981 and J&K 1991 values in the Census are interpolated by the Census. No value is estimated by this pipeline.
meta.method: Population: official state row of Table A-2, except AP, TG, JK, LA (sum of districts when every district has a value) and DH (sum of the two UT rows). Sex ratio = females per 1000 males from the same rows. Urban share 2011 = urban population / population from census2011_district. Literacy 2011 = literate / (population - age 0-6) from census2011_district. Literacy 1951-2001 and urban share 1991-2001: published tables as listed in the coverage note.
meta.redistributed_via: Economic Survey 2021-22 and SSES 2017 are Government of India publications that republish Census tables.
